moments.text: Infrared sensor pointed into clouds, crosshair at centre, black redaction boxes. A small white dot sits left of the crosshair as clouds drift past.
The clouds clear to an even grey sky; the white dot stays in the upper left, slowly sinking toward the middle left.
The view swings: the dot slides right, through the crosshair, to well right of centre.
The view swings back and the dot returns to the left of the crosshair.
The dot holds left of the crosshair, slowly rising into the upper left.
The dot smears into a short streak, races to the left edge and leaves the frame. 9 frames (~0.3 s).
Clouds drift through the now-empty view; the grey sky is clear again for the last few seconds.
